subject: Request: Grandfathered Tiered Discount for Multi-year Contract (Acme Automation)
messages:
From: Nora Patel <nora.patel@acme-automation.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: New proposal — multi-year commitment + pricing asks

Irene / Ben,

Thanks again for the pilot throughput — the team is ready to move to a three-year committed plan. Before we lock in procurement and legal, Acme has two non-standard asks we need written confirmation on:

1) Grandfathering: hold the effective per-token price for our existing SKU for the first 24 months of the new term (we want to avoid sudden increases as we scale).
2) Uplift cap / renewal protection: cap any contract price increases at 8% year-over-year during the three-year term and for the first renewal thereafter; we want contractual protection against large renewals.

We attached a redlined proposal and a target signature date of Sept 30 so procurement can hit FY bookings. Please let us know if these are doable or what you'd counter.

Attachment: Acme_Redwood_PROPOSAL_3yr_v1.pdf (proposal, 2 pages)

Best,
Nora Patel
Head of Cloud Procurement
Acme Automation
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-09-18T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: New proposal — multi-year commitment + pricing asks

Team — forwarding Acme's request. High-level: they want a 3yr committed contract but with two non-standard protections (24-month grandfathered price and 8% uplift cap including first renewal). They want to close Sept 30.

Why I'm escalating: both asks materially increase our revenue certainty risk and constrain future pricing. We should cover counter-proposals and a guardrail for us (minimum annual committed spend / minimum usage tiers).

Please respond with: 1) redlineable language we can accept, 2) minimum thresholds/commitments to pair with the protections, and 3) whether this needs exec approval or can be handled at deal desk level.

Nora / Kyle (from Acme) are looped in for context.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Director, Sales Strategy
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-09-19T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: New proposal — multi-year commitment + pricing asks

Irene — analysis and suggested approach below. I ran model-level economics and pull-through scenarios (see attached spreadsheet). Key points:

- Acme historical usage: current ARR run-rate ~ $1.2M with steady growth; committed 3yr would be meaningful.
- Grandfathering request is equivalent to a retroactive discount on incremental usage if prices rise; we can grant a limited grandfather (first 18 months) rather than 24 months.
- 8% uplift cap is high relative to our target price path; recommend we counter with a 6% cap on list price increases and explicitly carve out quantization/feature-driven surcharges.

Concrete recommendation (redline language to legal):
1) Grandfathering: Redwood will hold the Effective Unit Price for the specified SKU for the initial 18 months of the Term for volumes up to the committed usage band. Excess consumption above the committed band billed at prevailing rates.
2) Uplift cap: Annual list price increases during the Term shall not exceed 6% per year. For the first Renewal Term, price increases shall not exceed the lesser of 6% or CPI + 2%.
3) Minimum commitment: require a $900k annual committed spend baseline or failure to hit 90% of committed spend in any contract year triggers price re-opener / true-up.

If you want to keep the 24-month grandfathering to preserve the relationship, we can accept 24 months only if Acme moves to a $1.5M annual commit and agrees to an initial first-year blended discount no greater than 25%.

Attachment: deal_math_acme.xlsx (sensitivity model)

Marissa
Senior Deal Desk Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, irene_choi@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-09-20T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: New proposal — multi-year commitment + pricing asks

Numbers check — quick finance take:

- With the 18-month grandfather + $900k annual commit (Marissa rec), unit economics remain accretive: NPV of expected cash flows at our 12% discount rate remains positive and preserves margin targets.
- If we concede 24-month grandfathering without raising the annual minimum, margin erosion is ~4-6% vs baseline; acceptable only if strategic upsell probability > 65%.
- The 6% cap on list increases is acceptable, but we should add a narrow escalation exception for costs beyond our control (e.g., cloud pass-throughs > 15% YoY) — wording to be handled by legal.

Finance approval conditions:
1) Approve as long as final contract includes $900k committed ARR, 6% annual cap, 18-month grandfather, and a usage true-up clause (90% threshold).
2) If sales wants 24-month grandfathering, require $1.5M committed ARR or an escrow / upfront prepayment covering 12 months.

I'll greenlight once legal confirms language for the exceptions and Ops confirms we can support the committed capacity scheduling.

Vivek Kulkarni
VP Finance
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Nora Patel <nora.patel@acme-automation.com>, Kyle Jensen <kyle.jensen@acme-automation.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, irene_choi@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-09-22T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Decision: Acme 3yr commitment — approved with conditions

Nora / Kyle — thanks for your patience. We appreciate Acme's strong partnership and are prepared to move forward on a three-year committed agreement with the following agreed terms (final language to follow from legal):

- Grandfathering: Redwood will hold the Effective Unit Price for the named SKU for the initial 18 months of the Term for usage up to the committed band.
- Uplift cap: Annual list price increases during the Term capped at 6%. For the first Renewal, increases capped at the lesser of 6% or CPI + 2%.
- Minimum commitment: $900,000 committed ARR per year. Failure to hit at least 90% of committed spend triggers a true-up and potential price re-opener.

Condtions: Legal will add a limited force-majeure/cloud-pass-through exception for outsized infrastructure costs. Ops will validate capacity scheduling; we expect no change to go-live timelines.

Action items:
- Laura Bennett (Legal) to send redline within 48 hours: https://docusign.com/ABC-REDACTED
- Marissa to update pricing sheet and HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345
- Acme to confirm acceptance of the $900k commit and sign the DocuSign packet by Sept 30 for FY recognition.

Attachment: redwood_3yr_t&c_draft.docx (draft T&C for review)

Ben Carter
GM, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
